**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

I checked the agreement for any most-favoured-nation / best-terms mechanic and found none:

- **Section 4 (Fees)** — license, maintenance/support, taxes and audit rights only; no pricing-comparison undertaking.
- **Exhibit B (Pricing / Revenue Sharing Fees / Payment Terms)** — fixed, redacted amounts for license, MarketSite.net access, maintenance and implementation fees, plus a two-way revenue share. No obligation for Corio to give Commerce One terms no less favourable than those offered to third parties, and no obligation to match third-party offers.
- **Exhibit D (Sales and Marketing Cooperation)** — expressly "non-binding," and contains no exclusivity or preferred-terms commitment.
- Full-text searches for *most favored, no less favorable/favourable, lowest, best price, other customers, similarly situated, comparable, preferential, discount* returned nothing relevant.

This matches the playbook's **preferred position** — no MFN obligation on the Customer — so nothing to redline. Worth noting for the negotiation file: there is also no MFN *in our favour*, so if Corio wants best-pricing protection as its volume of Corio Customer subscriptions grows, that would be an affirmative ask against Exhibit B rather than a defensive edit.
